steps.title: Project Initialization and Meta Setup
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json and define the package name com.piccraftphotoeditor.app and application name PicCraft Photo Editor.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Configure app/build.gradle and root build.gradle for Gradle 8.5, AGP 8.3.2, Java 17, compiling and targeting SDK 34.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Establish AndroidManifest.xml with suitable hardware acceleration, file access permissions, and single-screen orientation lock.

steps.title: Design Main Layout Interface
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml offering a clean dark-slate theme layout with a drawing board workspace, visual filter horizontal scroll grids, and adjustment control panels.

steps.title: Implement Custom Interactive Drawing Workspace View
steps.description: Build the core Custom PhotoEditorView inside MainActivity to support canvas rendering, freehand drawing with customizable brushes, scaling, text rendering, and image matrix math.

steps.title: Integrate Media Loading and Scaling Operations
steps.description: Develop safe Android Intent handlers to read images from system gallery and downscale large high-resolution camera images to fit workspace memory.

steps.title: Develop Pixel-Level Photo Filters
steps.description: Program fast hardware-accelerated filters including Grayscale, Sepia, Invert, Vignette, Warm, and Cold styles using ColorMatrix transformations.

steps.title: Implement Precision Image Adjustment Logic
steps.description: Configure real-time seekers for brightness, contrast, and color saturation scaling directly applied onto the photo canvas rendering pipeline.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Text and Doodle Tools
steps.description: Add multi-color support, brush size customization, and screen coordinates touch tracking to let users draw and place movable texts anywhere over photos.

steps.title: Add Transform Tools (Rotate, Flip, Crop)
steps.description: Incorporate image manipulation algorithms to rotate 90 degrees, flip vertically/horizontally, and crop current selections without losing clarity.

steps.title: Integrate MediaStore Storage Exporter
steps.description: Construct safe exporter routines that combine all edits (filters, drawings, adjustments) and save high-fidelity JPEG output directly into public pictures folders.

steps.title: Building PicCraft Photo Editor
steps.description: Assemble and compile the debug APK configuration to verify proper build output, memory usage optimization, and UI performance.
